Implementation summary covering source changes, decisions, plan deviations, and full Phase 4 verification results.

completion_data.completion_summary: Removed the stale self-sync early-return guard in sync.lua's M.load_all_globally() and replaced it with a narrow lib/tests self-load exclusion (with a non-silent summary note), unblocking the nvim repo's own .claude/ deploy-tree regeneration via <leader>al; verified via a scratchpad headless harness against fake dirs, with all 5 Phase 4 assertions observed and passing and the real .claude tree confirmed untouched throughout.

memory_candidates.content: When a Lua module's sync/loader function reaches an interactive vim.fn.confirm() dialog, headless nvim testing cannot safely drive past it. Verify at the layer below the interactive gate (the pure scan/compute function the interactive function calls into) instead, and explicitly document what could not be observed rather than inferring the interactive path also works.

For self-referential sync/copy operations (source dir == destination dir), keep categories with a genuinely distinct source unconditionally synced, and add a narrow, explicitly-flagged skip (an underscore-prefixed metadata key) only for categories whose source and destination paths are byte-identical. Surface the skip in any user-facing summary so a resulting zero-count never reads as a complete/successful operation.
